# Er. Chetan Kumar Sarraf — Civil Engineer & Interior Designer in Birgunj, Nepal

> Official portfolio, civil engineering toolkit, Room BOQ calculator, NBC 205 site bylaws planner, and architectural design studio of Er. Chetan Kumar Sarraf in Birgunj, Parsa, Nepal.

Er. Chetan Kumar Sarraf is a Nepal Engineering Council (NEC) registered Civil Engineer (`76273 Civil "A"`) and spatial/interior designer serving Birgunj, Parsa, Madhesh Province, and Nepal with 2D AutoCAD drawings, 3D interior visualization, turnkey execution, Vastu planning, and transparent BOQ estimation.

- [Home — Studio & Portfolio](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/home): Main overview featuring featured interior projects, structural services, studio highlights, and direct inquiry form.
- [Works — Architectural & Interior Portfolio](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/works): Curated residential, commercial, clinic, showroom, and custom interior execution showcase.
- [Projects Directory](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/projects/): Crawl-ready project index with scope summaries, square footage, locations, and detailed case-study views.
- [Engineering & Design Journal](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/journal): Long-form technical articles covering NBC 205 structural compliance, Birgunj interior design trends, Vastu, and construction planning.
- [Technical Articles Archive](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/articles/): Searchable archive of civil engineering guides and interior architecture resources in Nepal.
- [Services & Design Scope](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/services/): Detailed service offerings spanning interior design, Vastu planning, 2D municipal drawings, 3D renders, and turnkey build supervision.
- [About Er. Chetan Kumar Sarraf](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/about/): Credentials, NEC registration, Birgunj practice background, ethos, and design philosophy.

## Featured Projects & Articles

- [Contemporary Master Bedroom with Custom Wardrobes](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/projects/contemporary-master-bedroom/): Full residential bedroom interior with custom wardrobes, study desk, and layered false ceiling lighting.
- [School Office Renovation — Trijuddha High School Birgunj](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/projects/school-office-renovation/): Institutional principal office interior redesign in Birta, Birgunj, Parsa, Nepal.
- [Office Interior at Bypass Road (Client: Aalok Tulshyan)](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/projects/aalok-tulshyan-office-interior/): Corporate office interior featuring acoustic wood detailing, lighting, and custom seating.
- [Modular Kitchen vs Carpenter Kitchen in Birgunj](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/articles/modular-kitchen-vs-carpenter-kitchen-birgunj/): Technical cost, durability, and Terai moisture-resistance comparison for homeowners in Nepal.

## Engineering Tools & Calculators

- [Site CAD & Municipal Bylaws Planner](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/sitecad): Interactive plot setback, FAR, ground coverage, and NBC 205 compliance planning tool.
- [Room BOQ & Quantity Estimator](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/boq): Live Bill of Quantities estimator for flooring, false ceiling, wall panelling, paint, electrical, and modular joinery.
- [Civil Engineering & Vastu Hub](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/civilhub): Steel bar weight calculator, concrete mix ratios, unit converters, Vastu compass, and Nepali Panchanga tools.
- [Rates & Material Cost Guide](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/rates): Up-to-date Nepal construction & interior finishing rate reference in NPR per sq.ft.
- [360° VR Architectural Walkthroughs](https://chetankumarsarraf.com.np/360vr): Interactive panoramic interior visualizations and immersive spatial previews.
